About Hart Leather
Hart Leather is a premium leather goods brand born in Patagonia and handmade in Argentina. Our signature Hart Weekender is designed for travelers and style-conscious men who value timeless design, craftsmanship, and quality materials.

What makes us different
Each Weekender combines traditional Argentine leather craftsmanship with a refined, versatile design made for weekend travel, business trips, and everyday use.

How affiliates can earn
Affiliates earn 15% commission on every qualifying sale. With the Hart Weekender priced at $695, that equals $104.25 commission per bag sold.

How to promote us
Affiliates may promote Hart Leather through approved social media content, blogs, editorial content, travel and style recommendations, product features, and other approved channels using their unique affiliate link and personalized discount code.

Who we’re looking for
We’re especially interested in partners whose audiences are interested in men’s style, travel, luxury lifestyle, craftsmanship, and premium accessories.
payout_period: Commissions are paid monthly via PayPal once the minimum payout threshold of $50 is reached.

Acceptance and enrollment

By submitting an application, checking the agreement box, or participating after approval, the affiliate agrees to these Terms & Conditions and the Affiliate Applicant Privacy Notice. An application is not accepted until HART approves it.

Affiliate relationship

The affiliate acts as an independent contractor and is not an employee, agent, joint venturer, franchisee, or legal representative of HART. The affiliate has no authority to bind HART or make commitments on HART’s behalf.

Commission and tracking

Approved affiliates may earn a 15% commission on qualified sales attributed through their unique referral link or, when issued, affiliate coupon code. Link attribution uses a 30-day tracking window. Commission eligibility remains subject to the active UpPromote settings and HART’s validation of the order.

No commission is payable on cancelled, returned, refunded, charged-back, fraudulent, incorrectly attributed, or prohibited self-referral orders. HART may correct tracking or commission errors and may withhold or reverse commission connected to a violation.

Payments and taxes

Payments are processed according to the payout schedule, method, currency, and minimum threshold displayed in UpPromote or communicated by HART. The affiliate must provide accurate payment and tax information when requested. The affiliate is solely responsible for taxes, reporting obligations, fees, and charges applicable to affiliate earnings.

Promotion and disclosure

The affiliate must comply with applicable advertising, privacy, email, consumer-protection, endorsement, and platform rules. Any material connection to HART, including the possibility of earning commission, must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously with the promotion itself.

Promotions must be truthful and based on genuine experience or approved product information. Affiliates may not hide disclosures, use vague wording that consumers are unlikely to understand, or rely only on a profile page or platform tool when an additional disclosure is required.

Brand license and intellectual property

HART retains all rights in its trademarks, logos, product photography, copy, and other materials. During active participation, HART grants the affiliate a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable right to use approved assets solely to promote HART under this program.

The affiliate must stop using HART assets immediately when requested or when participation ends. No ownership rights are transferred.

Prohibited activities

• Spam, unsolicited bulk messages, or email sent without required consent.

• Cookie stuffing, forced clicks, hidden redirects, adware, or other artificial attribution.

• Paid search or social advertising, boosted content, media buying, or retargeting without prior written approval.

• Bidding on HART trademarks, misspellings, or confusingly similar terms.

• False advertising, misleading claims, fake reviews, impersonation, or deceptive promotions.

• Unauthorized coupon distribution, coupon-site placement, or alteration of a HART offer.

• Self-referrals or purchases made primarily to generate commission.

• Domain names, social handles, profiles, or pages that impersonate HART or suggest they are owned by HART.

• Use of HART content or customer information for an unrelated purpose.

Monitoring, suspension, and termination

HART may review applications, referral activity, promotional content, traffic sources, coupon use, and orders to protect customers and program integrity. HART may request information reasonably needed to verify compliance.

HART may suspend or terminate participation for inactivity, noncompliance, suspected fraud, reputational risk, or program needs. Commission tied to fraud, abuse, or a material violation may be withheld or forfeited. Valid approved commission earned before termination remains subject to the normal validation and payout rules.

Program changes and discontinuation

HART may modify, pause, or discontinue the program, including commission rates, eligible products, attribution rules, and operational settings. Changes apply from the stated effective date and will not retroactively remove commission already earned on qualified sales before that date.

Disclaimer and limitation of liability

HART does not guarantee approval, traffic, conversions, sales, revenue, or a minimum commission amount. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, HART is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from participation in the program, platform interruptions, or third-party services.

Agreement acceptance

The affiliate’s electronic acceptance through UpPromote and continued participation after approval constitute acceptance of these Terms & Conditions. If the affiliate does not agree, the affiliate must not apply or participate.
